statement: xpad's default wired 045e:028e mapping is ABS_HAT0X/Y range -1..1; mapping flags can emit BTN_DPAD_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN instead. Wireless XTYPE_XBOX360W retains historical axis plus button behavior, and 045e:0719 registry entry has MAP_DPAD_TO_BUTTONS.
